svg.title: The Second Derivative Test at a critical point
svg.desc: Three panels, each with a flat (dashed) tangent line at x = c where f'(c) = 0. Left: the graph is concave up there, f''(c) > 0, so f has a relative minimum. Middle: concave down, f''(c) < 0, a relative maximum. Right: f''(c) = 0, and three functions show that anything can happen: x to the fourth has a minimum, negative x to the fourth has a maximum, and x cubed has neither.
svg.text: concave up at a flat point
concave down at a flat point
any of the three can happen
